sources_purpose: Where Lodestar finds torrents: the DHT and the other sources. Each source can be turned on or off and given a share of the fetch work. Turning one on or off takes effect at the next start.
sources_load_failed: Couldn't load the sources. Nothing was changed.
sources_stale: Couldn't refresh. What you see may be out of date.
sources_empty_text: This build has no source plugins.
sources_setup_consent: Needs setup before it can be turned on: you must first read and accept what it does. Setup is not available on this screen yet.
sources_setup_endpoints: Needs setup before it can be turned on: you must first accept the sites it contacts. Setup is not available on this screen yet.
sources_setup_credentials: Needs setup before it can be turned on: it needs your account details first. Setup is not available on this screen yet.
sources_setup_password: Needs setup before it can be turned on: it asks for your password. Setup is not available on this screen yet.
sources_addresses_heading: It contacts these addresses. Accepting covers exactly these; a change asks again.
sources_addresses_none: No address is listed yet, so it can't contact anything.
sources_error_network: Couldn't reach Lodestar. Nothing was changed.
sources_error_needs_setup: This source needs setup before it can be turned on. Nothing was changed.
sources_error_purge_running: A purge is running for this source. Nothing was changed.
sources_error_code: The change was refused ({code}). Nothing was changed.
